support_claim: The commercial notes state that Helion Industrial Systems Ltd is a different company from Helion Robotics Ltd, which is the name on CRM record HEL-441, while registry row 11847299 names HELION INDUSTRIAL SYSTEMS LTD.
justification: Under the identity contract, DISTINCT is licensed because the packet provides establishing evidence—not mere name similarity or lack of contradiction—that the left referent (Helion Robotics Ltd via HEL-441) and the right referent (HELION INDUSTRIAL SYSTEMS LTD via 11847299) are separate legal counterparties.
